record_title: Finite-frequency pluriharmonic Fock Toeplitz operators form a zero-divisor-free algebra
limitations: Only finite sums of polynomial amplitudes times linear exponentials are treated. The theorem does not settle arbitrary entire functions of exponential type, bounded pluriharmonic symbols outside this class, infinite-frequency closures, or boundedness of the generally unbounded generators on all of Fock space. No quantitative degree bound is given for the polynomial witness.
